AGENDA
  SPECIAL MEETING: AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or requests for assistance,
call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and
available for viewing on the City’s website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. Audit Reports are
available for viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-performance-
and-audit/internal-audit/audit-reports.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All
documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the City Clerk’s Office at 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA
91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the service
as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-2090, at least 24 hours
prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

  January 27, 2020 at 8:00 AM

 1. ROLL CALL

 2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The agenda for the January 27, 2020 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on Thursday,
  January 23, 2020 on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

  A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the Audit Committee is hereby called to meet at 8:00 a.m.,
  on Monday, January 27, 2020, in the Municipal Services Building, 633 E. Broadway, Room 105,
  Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following items(s) of business; to wit:

 3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

 4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on October 28, 2019
 5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Director of Finance, re: Selection of external auditor
  1. Motion to approve and recommend to City Council White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans,
  LLP as the City’s next external auditor.
 6. REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 12/31/2019 -Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit
  Manager
  b. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Report to the Audit Committee
  from Eide Bailly, LLP - Michele Flynn, Director of Finance

7. AUDIT COMMITTEE /STAFF COMMENTS

8. NEW BUSINESS

9. ADJOURNMENT

  ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SERVICE

Members of the public may address the Audit Committee regarding any item in this notice. Service of the
above Call for a Special Public Meeting of the Audit Committee at the time and place above designated, is

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  January 27, 2020

1.  ROLL CALL: 8:02 a.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy (absent),
  Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian (absent)

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Special Audit Committee meeting of January 27, 2020 was posted
  on Thursday, January 23, 2020 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A.  Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on Monday,
  October 28, 2019

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:  O’Shaughnessy, Satoorian
  Absent:

Item 6b taken out of order

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  B.  Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Report to the Audit
  Committee from Eide Bailly, LLP – Michele Flynn, Director of Finance

  Mr. Alwin DeLeon, Accounting Manager gave a report on the Comprehensive Annual
  Financial Report (CAFR) timeline, process and results. Mr. David Showalter, Partner with
  Eide Bailly, LLP, the City’s External Auditor gave a presentation to the Audit Committee and
  answered questions regarding the City’s fiscal year ended June 30, 2019 Audit.
 Audit Committee Minutes
January 27, 2020

  Chair Amirian thanked Mr. David Showalter for the past several years of work with the City of
  Glendale.

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A.  Director of Finance re: Selection of External Auditor
  1.  Motion to approve and recommend to City Council White, Nelson, Diehl,
  Evans, LLP as the City’s next External Auditor

  Ms. Theresa Clark, Accounting Manager gave a detailed report on the process of selecting the
  External Auditor. Finance staff sent out an RFP to 14 accounting firms and received five
  responses. An External Auditor Selection Committee was formed which included City staff and
  the Audit Committee Chair, Mr. Zareh Amirian. The top three Audit firms were interviewed and
  White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans, LLP was recommended by the Selection Committee to be the
  City’s External Auditor.

  Ms. Stafanie Munoz, Partner and Mr. Nitin Patel, Partner with White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans,
  LLP introduced themselves and presented their firm’s qualifications along with a list of
  reference cities that they contract with as External Auditor.

  Chair Amirian thanked City staff for the thorough process that the City went through for
  selecting the new External Audit firm.

  A motion was made to approve and recommend to City Council White, Nelson, Diehl, Evans
  LLP as the City’s next External Auditor.

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:
  Absent:  O’Shaughnessy, Satoorian

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION

  A.  Internal Audit Activity Report as of December 31, 2019 – Jessie Zhang,
  Internal Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager updated the Audit Committee on the Internal Audit
  activity for quarter ended December 31, 2019.

  Three projects were completed in this time period:

  1) Multi-Project Affordable Housing Lottery Audit (Phase II)
  2) Monthly Housing Subsidy Program Application Form Design Review
  3) Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) Transmission Agreement Loss
  Accounting Audit

  2
 Audit Committee Minutes
January 27, 2020

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor presented the Monthly Housing Subsidy
  Program Application Form Design Review Audit. Mr. Philip Lanzafame, Director of Community
  Development Department was present and answered questions from Audit Committee
  members.

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor also presented the LADWP Transmission
  Agreement Loss Accounting Audit. Mr. Mark Young, Deputy General Manager of Glendale
  Water and Power was present and answered questions from Audit Committee members.

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager also updated the Audit Committee on projects in
  progress, continuous auditing activities, quarterly follow-up status, and advisory services
  provided by Internal Audit.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

  Chair Amirian thanked Eide Bailly, LLP, the City’s existing External Auditor for their
  work with the City for the past six years and said he looks forward to working with the
  City’s new Externa Audit firm. Chair Amirian also thanked City staff for the thorough
  work in the preparation and selection of the new firm.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None

9.  ADJOURNMENT

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Adjournment at 10:00 a.m.
